LanguageData.Anorexic.degreeDatas.0.label: anorexic
LanguageData.Anorexic.degreeDatas.0.description: {PAWN_nameDef} struggles with anorexia. {PAWN_pronoun} has a reduced appetite and needs less food to survive, but suffers from poor physique.
LanguageData.Brawny.degreeDatas.0.label: brawny
LanguageData.Brawny.degreeDatas.0.description: {PAWN_nameDef} is exceptionally strong and muscular. {PAWN_pronoun} has impressive physical capabilities and excels in tasks requiring raw strength.
LanguageData.Obese.degreeDatas.0.label: obese
LanguageData.Obese.degreeDatas.0.description: {PAWN_nameDef} carries excess weight. {PAWN_pronoun} moves slower and is less attractive, but doesn't lack endurance.
LanguageData.Slender.degreeDatas.0.label: slender
LanguageData.Slender.degreeDatas.0.description: {PAWN_nameDef} has a thin, graceful build. {PAWN_pronoun} is attractive but lacks physical strength.
LanguageData.Agile.degreeDatas.0.label: agile
LanguageData.Agile.degreeDatas.0.description: {PAWN_nameDef} is exceptionally nimble and quick. {PAWN_pronoun} dodges attacks easily and moves with grace.
LanguageData.ExplosivePower.degreeDatas.0.label: explosive power
LanguageData.ExplosivePower.degreeDatas.0.description: {PAWN_nameDef} possesses explosive physical power, capable of launching enemies backward with sheer force.
